title: Figure 3: Strouhal Frequency vs Reynolds Number for Flow Over a Circular Cylinder
description: Line graph of Strouhal number St = fD/V (0-0.35) versus Reynolds number ReD = VD/ν on a logarithmic axis from 1E+01 to 1E+07. The curve rises to about 0.21, plateaus, dips slightly near 1E+05, and then rises to about 0.3 at 1E+07. The page also presents drag force and drag coefficient equations (4) and (5).
